Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Subject: Pod consolidation proposal + OKR anchors for Q3 — draft for exec readout

Team,

Attached is a short draft memo and the deck I'm planning to use for the QBR readout. High level summary:

- Why: We need to reduce cross-team handoffs and cut two layers of ownership that have increased mean time to production for infra optimizations.
- What: Consolidate four product-facing squads (Serving Core, Model Onboarding, Routing & Caching, Quantization Ops) into three outcome pods: Serving Reliability, Model Lifecycle, and Cost & Performance.
- Goals/OKR anchors for Q3 (proposed):
  1) Reduce p95 API tail latency by 20% for the Hosted API while maintaining model quality.
  2) Cut per-token inference cost by 18% through batching/quantization rollouts on hot paths.
  3) Ship unified model rollout tooling and automations that reduce manual rollbacks by 60%.

Asks:
- Please review the proposed pod scopes on pages 2–4 and flag any redlines by EOD Monday.
- Confirm whether we should surface the headcount-neutral language in the readout or be explicit about role reassignments.
- Feedback on the QBR talking points (page 6) — I'm trying to keep the exec section tight (~2 slides).

Attachments: consolidation_rationale.pdf (3 pages), qbr_talking_points_v1.docx

I'll incorporate feedback and send a version for Jonas' final review before the all-hands.

Thanks — Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Head of Platform Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pod consolidation proposal + OKR anchors for Q3 — draft for exec readout

Mina — thanks for the crisp draft. Quick notes:

- Strong + on the three-pod framing — simpler for GTM and SRE owners to understand boundaries.
- Make the customer impact more explicit on the first slide. Call out expected latency/cost delta in baseline dollars for our top 3 customers (PlatformBench is one).
- On headcount language: prefer "reassignment and consolidation" rather than vague "headcount-neutral" in the exec slides. We need transparency for managers during the Q&A.
- Page 5 (risk mitigation): add a bullet on staged canaries and automatic fallback to lower-capacity model variants in case of regressions.

Can you iterate and send me an updated packet by Friday morning? I want something I can present to the CEO in the pre-read.

-Jonas
